description: TEE (Trusted Execution Environment) blueprint capability — operators run jobs inside an enclave (Intel TDX / AWS Nitro / Phala dStack) and produce a remote-attestation-backed proof. Apply to tangle-blueprint for private-compute, confidential data processing, or regulated workload jobs.

buildHints.whenToUse: Attach when the blueprint must run in an enclave — handling private keys, regulated PII, or producing attested outputs for downstream trust.
firstSteps: Pick a backend in tee-config.json (intel-tdx | aws-nitro | phala-dstack)
Wire the attestation verifier in your job's verify_result.rs
Emit the RA quote alongside the job output
